name: Dibrother Simple Popup
author: Di Brother

sections.description:
Dibrother Simple Popup provides an easy-to-use interface for creating custom popups. You can add any content (text, images, links), control the size, and set specific display rules.

All Features Included:
* Create popup content with the WordPress editor.
* Customize popup width and overlay transparency.
* Control how often the popup reappears (every page load, daily, weekly, or monthly).
* Choose where to display the popup: homepage, all posts, all pages.
* Target specific posts and pages for display.
* Choose when the popup appears: immediately, after a time delay, or after the user scrolls down the page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the dibrother-simple-popup.zip file through the ‘Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin’ screen in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Dibrother Simple Popup” menu to configure the settings.
